name: portfolio
title: Portfolio review
subtitle: Read-only. Amounts stay in each project currency.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.sql: select name,manager,status,approved_finish,overdue_tasks,high_risks,pending_changes from portfolio_status order by name

sections.title: Budget by project currency
sections.sql: select name,currency,approved_budget,round(actual_cost,2) actual_cost,round(approved_budget-actual_cost,2) remaining_budget from portfolio_status order by name

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,project,item,owner,due_date from attention_items order by due_date

sections.title: People and hours
sections.sql: select week_start,name,weekly_hours,allocated_hours,overbooked_hours,projects from capacity_week order by week_start,name

sections.title: Predecessors not finished
sections.sql: select project,task,start_date,predecessor,predecessor_project,predecessor_finish from dependency_watch order by project,task
